name: boost
status_note: NOT yet executed. Boost is consumed headers-only, so the 'build' step is a copy of the header tree — but the acquire step still needs a real archive hash, which deps.lock.json currently records as null with a reason.

acquire.blocked_by: That field is null: the installed 1.90.0 predates the cached homebrew-core formula (1.92.0), so no hash for 1.90.0 is available offline. tools/deps/seed REFUSES to fetch it rather than trusting an unverified download.

features.note: Forge links no Boost library. Only three headers are reachable from the vendored planegcs sources, so the activated prefix could in principle be trimmed to Boost.Graph + Boost.Math and their transitive includes; it is NOT trimmed today because the header closure has not been measured.

provides.note: share/LICENSE_1_0.txt is listed because the CURRENT Homebrew prefix does not ship it — `find <prefix> -maxdepth 3 -iname '*LICENSE*'` returns nothing — which makes the generated attribution record INCOMPLETE. A Forge-built port must fix that; the check is here so it cannot be forgotten.

smoke_test.description: planegcs is the only consumer; compiling it is the smoke test.
smoke_test.expect: GCS.cpp compiles, which requires boost/graph/adjacency_list.hpp and boost/graph/connected_components.hpp to resolve from the activated prefix

known_gaps: Boost 1.90.0's archive hash is unknown offline (see acquire.blocked_by). Until one ONLINE_SEED run records it, this port cannot be executed.
